transcript.speaker: Singer
transcript.text_en: Hello, hello, hello, my friend!

transcript.speaker: Singer
transcript.text_en: Wave your hand and say it again!

gloss.ru: Помаши рукой и скажи ещё раз!
gloss.uz: Qoʻl silkit va yana bir bor ayt!

transcript.speaker: All
transcript.text_en: Hello, hello, hello, my friend!

transcript.speaker: Tim
transcript.text_en: I'm Tim, I'm Tim. And what's your name?

gloss.ru: Я Тим, я Тим. А как тебя зовут?
gloss.uz: Men Timman, men Timman. Sening isming nima?

transcript.speaker: Lola
transcript.text_en: I'm Lola, Lola! Let's play a game!

transcript.speaker: Tim
transcript.text_en: Nice to meet you, Lola!

transcript.speaker: Lola
transcript.text_en: Nice to meet you, too!

transcript.speaker: Tim
transcript.text_en: Good morning, Lola! How are you?

transcript.speaker: Lola
transcript.text_en: I'm fine, thank you! I'm happy today!

transcript.speaker: All
transcript.text_en: Hello, hello, hip, hip, hooray!

transcript.speaker: Singer
transcript.text_en: Goodbye, goodbye, see you soon!

transcript.speaker: Singer
transcript.text_en: Wave to the sun and wave to the moon!

gloss.uz: Quyoshga qoʻl silkit, oyga qoʻl silkit!

transcript.speaker: All
transcript.text_en: Hello, hello, hello, my friend!

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: Hi! What can I get you today?

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text_en: Hi! I'd like a cup of tea, please.

gloss.ru: Здравствуйте! Я бы хотел чашку чая, пожалуйста.
gloss.uz: Salom! Bir piyola choy xohlardim, iltimos.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: Sure. Black tea or green tea?

gloss.uz: Albatta. Qora choymi yoki koʻk choy?

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text_en: Green tea, please. And a hot chocolate for my son.

gloss.ru: Зелёный, пожалуйста. И горячий шоколад для сына.
gloss.uz: Koʻk choy, iltimos. Oʻgʻlimga esa issiq shokolad.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: Small or large?

transcript.speaker: Sami
transcript.text_en: Small, please! Can I have cream on top?

gloss.ru: Маленький, пожалуйста! А можно сверху сливки?
gloss.uz: Kichigi, iltimos! Ustiga qaymoq qoʻshsa boʻladimi?

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: Of course! Anything to eat?

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text_en: Two apple muffins, please.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: Sorry, we've only got one apple muffin left.

gloss.ru: Извините, остался только один яблочный маффин.
gloss.uz: Kechirasiz, faqat bitta olmali keks qoldi.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: We've got banana muffins, too.

transcript.speaker: Sami
transcript.text_en: Banana is OK! I love bananas.

gloss.uz: Bananlisi ham boʻlaveradi! Men bananni yaxshi koʻraman.

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: Great. To drink here or to take away?

gloss.uz: Ajoyib. Shu yerdami yoki olib ketasizmi?

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text_en: To drink here, please. How much is that?

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: That's nine pounds fifty, please.

transcript.speaker: Adam
transcript.text_en: Here you are. Thank you!

transcript.speaker: Ella
transcript.text_en: Thank you! I'll bring it to your table.

gloss.ru: Спасибо! Я принесу к вашему столику.

phrases.en: I'd like a cup of tea
Can I have cream on top?

transcript.speaker: Frank
transcript.text_en: Good morning! Fresh fruit and vegetables!

gloss.ru: Доброе утро! Свежие фрукты и овощи!
gloss.uz: Xayrli tong! Yangi meva va sabzavotlar!

transcript.speaker: Mira
transcript.text_en: Good morning! How much are the tomatoes?

transcript.speaker: Frank
transcript.text_en: They're three pounds a kilo.

transcript.speaker: Mira
transcript.text_en: And the cucumbers?

transcript.speaker: Frank
transcript.text_en: Two pounds a kilo. They're very fresh today.

gloss.ru: Два фунта за килограмм. Сегодня очень свежие.
gloss.uz: Kilosi ikki funt. Bugun juda yangi.

transcript.speaker: Mira
transcript.text_en: One kilo of tomatoes and two kilos of cucumbers, please.

gloss.ru: Килограмм помидоров и два килограмма огурцов, пожалуйста.
gloss.uz: Bir kilo pomidor va ikki kilo bodring, iltimos.

transcript.speaker: Frank
transcript.text_en: Here you are. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Mira
transcript.text_en: Are these melons sweet?

transcript.speaker: Frank
transcript.text_en: Very sweet! They're five pounds each.

gloss.ru: Очень сладкие! Пять фунтов за штуку.
gloss.uz: Juda shirin! Har biri besh funt.

transcript.speaker: Mira
transcript.text_en: Five pounds? That's a bit expensive.

transcript.speaker: Frank
transcript.text_en: OK, four pounds fifty, just for you!

gloss.ru: Ладно, четыре пятьдесят — только для вас!
gloss.uz: Mayli, toʻrt funt ellik pens — faqat siz uchun!

transcript.speaker: Mira
transcript.text_en: Deal! How much is that all together?

transcript.speaker: Frank
transcript.text_en: Three, plus four, plus four fifty. Eleven pounds fifty.

gloss.ru: Три, плюс четыре, плюс четыре пятьдесят. Одиннадцать фунтов пятьдесят.
gloss.uz: Uch, qoʻshuv toʻrt, qoʻshuv toʻrt ellik. Oʻn bir funt ellik pens.

transcript.speaker: Mira
transcript.text_en: Here's twenty pounds.

transcript.speaker: Frank
transcript.text_en: And here's your change: eight pounds fifty. Have a nice day!

gloss.ru: А вот ваша сдача: восемь фунтов пятьдесят. Хорошего дня!
gloss.uz: Mana qaytimingiz: sakkiz funt ellik pens. Kuningiz yaxshi oʻtsin!

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text_en: Excuse me! Can you help me? I think I'm lost.

gloss.ru: Простите! Вы можете мне помочь? Кажется, я заблудилась.
gloss.uz: Kechirasiz! Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Adashib qoldim shekilli.

transcript.speaker: Timur
transcript.text_en: Of course! Where do you want to go?

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text_en: To the history museum. Is it near here?

transcript.speaker: Timur
transcript.text_en: Yes, it's not far. Go straight on to the traffic lights.

gloss.ru: Да, недалеко. Идите прямо до светофора.
gloss.uz: Ha, uzoq emas. Svetoforgacha toʻgʻriga yuring.

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text_en: Straight on to the traffic lights. OK.

transcript.speaker: Timur
transcript.text_en: Then turn right. The museum is next to a big park.

gloss.ru: Потом поверните направо. Музей рядом с большим парком.
gloss.uz: Keyin oʻngga buriling. Muzey katta bogʻning yonida.

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text_en: Turn right, next to the park. Is it far?

gloss.ru: Направо, рядом с парком. Это далеко?

transcript.speaker: Timur
transcript.text_en: No, it's about five minutes on foot.

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text_en: Great! Is there a café near the museum?

gloss.ru: Отлично! А рядом с музеем есть кафе?

transcript.speaker: Timur
transcript.text_en: Yes, there's a nice café opposite the museum.

gloss.ru: Да, напротив музея есть хорошее кафе.
gloss.uz: Ha, muzeyning qarshisida yaxshi kafe bor.

transcript.speaker: Kate
transcript.text_en: Thank you so much!

transcript.speaker: Timur
transcript.text_en: You're welcome! Enjoy your day in Tashkent!

gloss.ru: Не за что! Хорошего дня в Ташкенте!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text_en: Good evening, welcome to the Green Garden Hotel. How can I help you?

gloss.ru: Добрый вечер, добро пожаловать в отель «Green Garden». Чем могу помочь?
gloss.uz: Xayrli kech, «Green Garden» mehmonxonasiga xush kelibsiz. Qanday yordam bera olaman?

transcript.speaker: Farrukh
transcript.text_en: Hi, I have a reservation. My name is Farrukh Saidov.

gloss.ru: Здравствуйте, у меня бронь. Меня зовут Фаррух Саидов.
gloss.uz: Salom, mening bronim bor. Ismim Farrux Saidov.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text_en: Could you spell your last name, please?

transcript.speaker: Farrukh
transcript.text_en: S-A-I-D-O-V.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text_en: Thank you. A single room for three nights. Can I see your passport?

gloss.ru: Спасибо. Одноместный номер на три ночи. Можно ваш паспорт?
gloss.uz: Rahmat. Uch kechaga bir kishilik xona. Pasportingizni koʻrsam boʻladimi?

transcript.speaker: Farrukh
transcript.text_en: Here you are.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text_en: Thanks. You're in room four-oh-eight, on the fourth floor.

gloss.ru: Спасибо. Ваш номер — 408, на четвёртом этаже.

transcript.speaker: Farrukh
transcript.text_en: What time is breakfast?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text_en: From seven to half past ten, in the restaurant on the ground floor.

gloss.ru: С семи до половины одиннадцатого, в ресторане на первом этаже.
gloss.uz: Soat yettidan oʻn yarimgacha, birinchi qavatdagi restoranda.

transcript.speaker: Farrukh
transcript.text_en: Is there Wi-Fi in the room?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text_en: Yes, the password is on your key card.

transcript.speaker: Farrukh
transcript.text_en: Great. Could I have a late check-out on Sunday?

gloss.ru: Отлично. Можно в воскресенье выехать попозже?
gloss.uz: Ajoyib. Yakshanba kuni kechroq chiqib ketsam boʻladimi?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text_en: Let me see... Yes, you can stay until one o'clock.

gloss.ru: Сейчас посмотрю... Да, можете остаться до часу.
gloss.uz: Hozir qarayman... Ha, soat birgacha qolishingiz mumkin.

transcript.speaker: Farrukh
transcript.text_en: Perfect. Thank you very much.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text_en: You're welcome. Enjoy your stay!

phrases.en: Could you spell your last name

title.ru: Объявление в аэропорту и интервью с пассажиром
title.uz: Aeroportdagi eʼlon va yoʻlovchi bilan intervyu

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text_en: Attention, please. Flight 215 to London is delayed by forty minutes.

gloss.ru: Внимание! Рейс 215 в Лондон задерживается на сорок минут.
gloss.uz: Diqqat! Londonga uchadigan 215-reys qirq daqiqaga kechikmoqda.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text_en: The new departure time is eleven fifty.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text_en: Boarding will start at eleven twenty, at gate eight.

gloss.uz: Bortga chiqish soat 11:20 da, 8-chiqish eshigidan boshlanadi.

transcript.speaker: Sara
transcript.text_en: Hello! Can I ask you a few questions for our travel podcast?

gloss.ru: Здравствуйте! Можно задать вам несколько вопросов для нашего подкаста о путешествиях?
gloss.uz: Salom! Sayohat haqidagi podkastimiz uchun sizga bir nechta savol bersam boʻladimi?

transcript.speaker: Ravshan
transcript.text_en: Sure, no problem.

transcript.speaker: Sara
transcript.text_en: Where are you flying today?

transcript.speaker: Ravshan
transcript.text_en: To London. I'm going to visit my sister.

transcript.speaker: Sara
transcript.text_en: Your flight is delayed. How do you feel?

gloss.ru: Ваш рейс задерживается. Как вы к этому относитесь?

transcript.speaker: Ravshan
transcript.text_en: It's OK. Forty minutes isn't long.

gloss.ru: Ничего страшного. Сорок минут — это недолго.
gloss.uz: Hechqisi yoʻq. Qirq daqiqa uzoq emas.

transcript.speaker: Ravshan
transcript.text_en: I'm going to have a coffee and read my book.

transcript.speaker: Sara
transcript.text_en: Do you often travel by plane?

transcript.speaker: Ravshan
transcript.text_en: Two or three times a year. I always check in online.

gloss.ru: Два-три раза в год. Я всегда регистрируюсь онлайн.
gloss.uz: Yiliga ikki-uch marta. Men doim onlayn roʻyxatdan oʻtaman.

transcript.speaker: Sara
transcript.text_en: Any tips for other travellers?

transcript.speaker: Ravshan
transcript.text_en: Yes! Come early, and always listen to the announcements.

gloss.ru: Да! Приезжайте заранее и всегда слушайте объявления.
gloss.uz: Ha! Erta keling va eʼlonlarni doim tinglang.

transcript.speaker: Sara
transcript.text_en: Great tip! Have a good flight!

phrases.en: I'm going to visit my sister

transcript.speaker: Rebecca
transcript.text_en: Good morning! You must be Javlon. Welcome to the team!

gloss.ru: Доброе утро! Вы, должно быть, Жавлон. Добро пожаловать в команду!
gloss.uz: Xayrli tong! Siz Javlon boʻlsangiz kerak. Jamoaga xush kelibsiz!

transcript.speaker: Javlon
transcript.text_en: Good morning! Yes, I'm Javlon. Nice to meet you.

gloss.ru: Доброе утро! Да, я Жавлон. Приятно познакомиться.
gloss.uz: Xayrli tong! Ha, men Javlonman. Tanishganimdan xursandman.

transcript.speaker: Rebecca
transcript.text_en: Nice to meet you too. I'm Rebecca, the office manager.

gloss.ru: Мне тоже приятно. Я Ребекка, офис-менеджер.
gloss.uz: Men ham xursandman. Men Rebekka, ofis menejeriman.

transcript.speaker: Rebecca
transcript.text_en: Let me show you around. This is the kitchen. Tea and coffee are free.

gloss.ru: Давайте я вам всё покажу. Это кухня. Чай и кофе бесплатно.
gloss.uz: Keling, sizga hammasini koʻrsataman. Bu oshxona. Choy va qahva bepul.

transcript.speaker: Javlon
transcript.text_en: Great! Where is my desk?

transcript.speaker: Rebecca
transcript.text_en: It's over there, next to the window.

transcript.speaker: Rebecca
transcript.text_en: And this is Tom. He works in the marketing team.

gloss.ru: А это Том. Он работает в отделе маркетинга.
gloss.uz: Bu esa Tom. U marketing jamoasida ishlaydi.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text_en: Hi, Javlon! What do you do?

gloss.uz: Salom, Javlon! Siz nima ish qilasiz?

transcript.speaker: Javlon
transcript.text_en: I'm a junior accountant. I work with the finance team.

gloss.ru: Я младший бухгалтер. Работаю с финансовым отделом.
gloss.uz: Men kichik hisobchiman. Moliya jamoasi bilan ishlayman.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text_en: Cool. We usually have lunch at one. Do you want to join us?

gloss.ru: Здорово. Мы обычно обедаем в час. Хотите с нами?
gloss.uz: Zoʻr. Biz odatda soat birda tushlik qilamiz. Bizga qoʻshilasizmi?

transcript.speaker: Javlon
transcript.text_en: Yes, I'd love to. Thanks!

transcript.speaker: Rebecca
transcript.text_en: Your first meeting is at eleven, in room three.

gloss.ru: Ваша первая встреча в одиннадцать, в комнате три.
gloss.uz: Birinchi yigʻilishingiz soat oʻn birda, uchinchi xonada.

transcript.speaker: Javlon
transcript.text_en: Sorry, which room?

transcript.speaker: Rebecca
transcript.text_en: Room three, on the second floor.

transcript.speaker: Javlon
transcript.text_en: Got it. Thank you!

phrases.en: I work with the finance team
Do you want to join us?

transcript.speaker: Aziza
transcript.text_en: Hi, Jack! Any plans for the weekend?

gloss.ru: Привет, Джек! Есть планы на выходные?
gloss.uz: Salom, Jek! Dam olish kunlariga rejalaring bormi?

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text_en: Yes! On Saturday I'm going to play football with my friends.

gloss.ru: Да! В субботу собираюсь играть в футбол с друзьями.
gloss.uz: Ha! Shanba kuni doʻstlarim bilan futbol oʻynamoqchiman.

transcript.speaker: Aziza
transcript.text_en: Nice! Where do you play?

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text_en: In the park near my house. We play every Saturday morning.

gloss.ru: В парке рядом с домом. Мы играем каждую субботу утром.
gloss.uz: Uyim yaqinidagi bogʻda. Har shanba ertalab oʻynaymiz.

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text_en: What about you? What are you going to do?

transcript.speaker: Aziza
transcript.text_en: I'm going to visit my grandma in Samarkand.

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text_en: Oh! How are you going to get there?

gloss.ru: О! А как ты туда доберёшься?

transcript.speaker: Aziza
transcript.text_en: By train. It takes about two hours.

gloss.ru: На поезде. Это около двух часов.

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text_en: That's quick! What do you usually do there?

gloss.ru: Быстро! А что ты там обычно делаешь?
gloss.uz: Tez ekan! U yerda odatda nima qilasan?

transcript.speaker: Aziza
transcript.text_en: We cook together and walk in the old city.

gloss.ru: Мы вместе готовим и гуляем по старому городу.
gloss.uz: Birga ovqat pishiramiz va eski shaharda sayr qilamiz.

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text_en: Sounds lovely. Last weekend I just stayed at home.

gloss.ru: Звучит чудесно. А я в прошлые выходные просто сидел дома.
gloss.uz: Juda yoqimli. Men oʻtgan dam olish kunlari shunchaki uyda qoldim.

transcript.speaker: Aziza
transcript.text_en: Really? What did you do?

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text_en: I watched films and cleaned my room. Boring!

gloss.ru: Смотрел фильмы и убирался в комнате. Скукота!
gloss.uz: Kino koʻrdim va xonamni yigʻishtirdim. Zerikarli!

transcript.speaker: Aziza
transcript.text_en: Ha-ha! Well, have a great game on Saturday!

gloss.ru: Ха-ха! Что ж, хорошей игры в субботу!
gloss.uz: Ha-ha! Xoʻp, shanba kungi oʻyining zoʻr oʻtsin!

transcript.speaker: Jack
transcript.text_en: Thanks! Have a good trip!
